selected_problem: Fresh-main semantic graph canonicalizes lexical path aliases but silently retained the last of conflicting contents for the same canonical path, making graph symbols and meaning depend on input order.
decision_basis: The defect is narrow, directly falsifiable, and central to repository-reality integrity.

Existing Taowind Code consensus rules already establish that identical same-path variants may collapse while incompatible same-path variants fail closed, so this cycle reuses existing policy instead of inventing a new conflict architecture.
Hosted Developer Execution Runtime returned transient HTTP 502; this cycle uses DWAC_SOURCE_CONTRACT_REPLAY and does not claim a hosted DWAC success receipt.
change: Before semantic node construction, canonical path aliases with identical content collapse deterministically; aliases with differing content raise SEMANTIC_PATH_CONTENT_CONFLICT with the canonical path instead of last-write-wins.

validation.pre_fix_reproduction: PASS: focused regression failed against fresh main because no exception was raised, reproducing silent last-write behavior.

truth_boundary: This closes silent order-dependent content selection when lexical aliases normalize to one semantic path. The conflict currently fails closed by raising an error; it does not add provenance arbitration, filesystem re-observation, case-folding identity, Unicode normalization policy, full parser-grade module resolution, or arbitrary complex repository synthesis.
